rules.title: Explicit state schema
rules.text: Define graph state with an explicit schema and reducers for fields that merge updates, such as message lists.

rules.title: Checkpointer and thread_id
rules.text: Compile with a checkpointer and pass a thread_id in the config to persist and resume a conversation.

rules.title: Human approval with interrupt
rules.text: Use interrupt() for human approval. It needs a checkpointer, and the node restarts from its beginning on resume.

rules.title: Idempotent before interrupt
rules.text: Keep work that runs before an interrupt idempotent, because the node re-executes on resume.

rules.title: Recursion limit
rules.text: Set a recursion_limit and handle GraphRecursionError so loops end predictably.

rules.title: Stop before the limit
rules.text: Track remaining_steps in state and end gracefully before the limit instead of failing.

rules.title: Stable interrupt order
rules.text: If a node has several interrupt calls, keep their order stable because resume values are matched by index.

rules.title: Small nodes
rules.text: Keep nodes small and single-purpose so they can be tested and traced individually.

rules.title: Durable checkpointer
rules.text: Use a durable checkpointer such as Postgres in production, not the in-memory one.

rules.title: Test nodes as functions
rules.text: Test nodes as plain functions with fixed state, then test full flows with a fake model.
